title: Retrying LLM Client Tested with Fakes
instructions: Implement `Response`, `UpstreamError` and the async `RetryingClient` in `resilient.py`. The client receives its transport and `sleep` as constructor arguments and retries 429/500/502/503/504 with capped exponential backoff, honouring `retry_after`. Other 4xx/5xx statuses fail on the first attempt, and nothing sleeps after the last attempt.

evidence.label: Returns the body on first-try success without sleeping
Honours retry_after and caps it at max_delay
retry_after never makes the wait shorter than the backoff
Exponential backoff is capped at max_delay
Raises UpstreamError after N attempts and skips the final sleep
Non-retryable statuses raise after exactly one attempt
Raises ValueError when max_attempts is below 1
A one-attempt client gives up without sleeping
Response is a frozen dataclass with body and retry_after defaults
